documentNotes.title: Observational round. Questions — Clear sky
documentNotes.statement: During the tour you will approach to the examiner with “examination cards”. You will take randomly one examination card and show by hand the answers for questions of the problem 13 to the examiner. Be ready to answer. Other time is given for solution of the problem 14.

documentNotes.title: Time limit
documentNotes.statement: The maximum total time for all tasks is **35 minutes**.

problems.title: Directions and objects
problems.statement:
Show by hand the directions and objects included in the examination card. You should show the directions to the objects in any case, even when they are located below the horizon or hidden from the observer by buildings, trees, etc.

***1/3 of a minute*** *is done to show each object or direction.*

| 3 | **Aldebaran** (α Tau) | **Альдебаран** (α Tau) |
| 4 | **Sirius** (α CMa) | **Сириус** (α CMa) |

problems.title: The Moon
problems.statement: Determine for the time of the middle of the round and write down in the right column:

parts.statement: Astronomical azimuth of the moon (assume the $0^\circ$ azimuth corresponds to South direction, and the counting is clockwise).
The height of the Moon above the horizon.
Phase of the Moon (write a digit of number of days).
Constellation(s) in which the Moon is located (write the standard three-letter designation).
The angular distance between the Moon and Polaris
